info.description: M2 local API. Successful responses are validated before delivery; plans pin versioned entities and policy decisions.
info.title: WorldFuzz local task API

post.description: Register timestamped XYZ prediction/reference tracks, already in the same frame and metres. Does not control a device.

get.description: Read an integrity-checked registered sensor asset including source provenance and preserved input text.

post.description: Freeze metadata, history and registered blobs after run reconciliation.
Restore an owned backup to a separate copy; never overwrite the active catalog.
Freeze a bounded campaign, allowed mutations, immutable criteria, typed case plans and total budget.

case_indices.description: Zero-based Moving AI case indices (0 through 8). Index N selects canonical resource movingai:N, not ordinal N+1. Use find_resources to inspect the pinned case; movingai:8 means case_indices [8].

get.description: Read the immutable campaign, attempts and final report.

post.description: Start one campaign case as an ordinary durable job under the campaign budget.
Reduce terminal case results and freeze the complete phase/attempt ledger.

get.description: Discover exact supported profiles, operations and local execution limits.

post.description: Compare completed results only when their task inputs and evaluation protocol match.

get.description: Read a verified DatasetManifest, immutable split and native-reader round-trip receipt.

post.description: Prepare only: freeze a provenance-preserving dataset export plan with immutable group splits. Execution has NOT started; there is no run or export artifact. Execute the returned plan with execute_plan, or use run_goal with goal.operation export_dataset and explicit budgets. Confirm export only from a completed run and its existing hash-checked artifacts.
Compile a structured goal into an authorized typed plan. Provider contract mode makes zero model calls.

case_indices.description: Zero-based Moving AI case indices (0 through 8). Index N selects canonical resource movingai:N, not ordinal N+1. Use find_resources to inspect the pinned case; movingai:8 means case_indices [8].

post.description: Compile, prepare, execute and read one typed goal through scoped service tools. Same key resumes the same logical run. Waiting is not task failure. Campaigns require the campaign tools.

case_indices.description: Zero-based Moving AI case indices (0 through 8). Index N selects canonical resource movingai:N, not ordinal N+1. Use find_resources to inspect the pinned case; movingai:8 means case_indices [8].

resource_id.description: Exact resource ID returned by find_resources. Moving AI uses zero-based movingai:N; movingai:8 selects case_index 8. Explicit parameters must agree with this resource.

get.description: Read persisted service counters scoped to this workspace.

post.description: Describe one callable tool with exact input/output schemas. Adapter operations are parameters of compile_goal, not MCP tool names.

name.description: Bare service tool name from tools/list, e.g. get_result_report. Do not include the MCP server name or an adapter operation.

post.description: Authenticate a provisioned local organization principal and issue a workspace-scoped token.
Validate compatibility and freeze inputs, code identity and budget before any computation.

case_indices.description: Zero-based Moving AI case indices (0 through 8). Index N selects canonical resource movingai:N, not ordinal N+1. Use find_resources to inspect the pinned case; movingai:8 means case_indices [8].

post.description: Find included tasks and stored episodes; returns a bounded page, not episode arrays.

get.description: Read an integrity-checked result manifest, evidence and artifact references.

post.description: Read a hash-checked JSON artifact as nanoseconds-decimal.v1 without modifying original bytes. Not JSONL or binary export.

get.description: Read the same scoped evidence verdict for UI, embed and CI, with JSON and JUnit. Rechecks current access.

meaning.description: Short evidence statement. Moving AI lists canonical movingai:N and actual zero-based case_index. Dataset export is confirmed only after completed execution with existing hash-checked payload and manifest. Artifact references remain in get_result.

post.description: Independently check stored bytes or supported offline metrics; never imply physical replay.
Preview or delete selected old terminal artifacts; retain history and protect suites/campaigns.
Start one durable local job using a prepared digest and idempotency key. Poll get_run. Zero provider calls.

get.description: Read durable job status. Completion is separate from the task outcome.
Read durable run transitions, attempt history and retention state.
Read the atomic reservation, observed phase usage and explicitly unknown usage.

post.description: Request cooperative cancellation; retains completed evidence.
Reconcile an expired lease without replaying work; preserve attempts and partial evidence.
Explicitly resume one incomplete logical job under a retry key; preserve previous attempts.
Register a bounded ROS 1 or ROS 2 MCAP recording. Preserves exact bytes, timestamps, schemas, units and the declared frame; does not infer commands or flight outcomes.
Explicitly include unique compatible verified results in an immutable dataset-linked suite.

get.description: Read and revalidate an immutable task/run/evidence/dataset suite.

post.description: Import two TUM-format UTF-8 trajectories with exact matching timestamps. Preserves source text and hashes; evaluates XYZ only, no frame alignment or device control.
Recompute stored episode checks in a new run plan. Does not claim physics replay.
Find authorized verified results compatible with an exact dataset generation; never auto-include.
Create a workspace-local authenticated pull outbox; no external sending.
Read authorized durable run events from a workspace-local webhook outbox.
Read workspace-bound HMAC signed run events. Pull only; no outbound delivery.
Update a workspace lifetime quota with optimistic version matching; no usage reset.

get.description: Read quota limits, reservations, measured phases and explicit unknown consumption.
